- When sentiment is consistently positive (≥0.67) over recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast by 1–3% for next 5–10 days.  
- When sentiment is negative (≤0.33) or volatile, model often underestimates; adjust upward by 1–2% if recent price drop > 2% from 3-day avg.  
- After sharp price spikes (≥5% from prior 5-day high), model frequently overshoots; cap forecast at 10–15% below peak for next 7–14 days.  
- If true outcome shows strong mean reversion (price drops >3% from 10-day high), model often fails to correct; apply downward bias of 0.5–1.5% per day until reversion completes.  
- For 30-day horizon, model tends to overreact to sentiment shifts; use 3-day moving average of sentiment to smooth forecast and avoid extreme extrapolation.
